about_the_game:
SYNOPSIS

The rebel nation, Country N, has begun invading neighboring countries.

They possess nuclear weapons and pose a major threat to the world.

The international community dispatches a special forces unit to respond to this crisis.As an ace pilot of this unit,

the player will pilot a state-of-the-art fighter jet and fight to neutralize Country N's nuclear weapons and put down the rebellion.

ABOUT GAME SYSTEM

SUPER STRIPE is a high-speed flight combat game.

This game system is typified by the classic SEGA arcade game "Afterburner".

The controls are very simple, and you can wipe out enemies with multiple lock-ons.

The fundamental point is the sense of superiority, but it is a logical game design that can express new possibilities, including the viewpoint, sense of speed, and offense and defense, and I believe that it is a game system that can be further developed.

ABOUT STAGE

Players will invade using multiple lock-ons and Vulcans. The stage will progress depending on the distance invaded. There are 23 stages in total. The final stage will be stage 23. There is an area selection in certain stages. Each stage is diverse, with landscapes such as mountainous areas, valleys, lakes, oceans, and city buildings.

ABOUT GRAPHICS

These 3D graphics are expressed with Real-time GI.

ABOUT CONTROLS

[Keyboard]

Move RightCURSOR /Z GUN/X MISSILE/A Speed Low/S Speed High/Enter Select /F11 fullscreen

[GamePad]

Move LStick or Lcursor/A GUN/B Missile/X Speed Low/Y Speed High/Select a GUN

  • OS: windows10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX1060 / Radeon RX
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

  • OS: windows11

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX2070 / Radeon RX 5700XT
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
